title: A stack that also reports its minimum
storyTitle: The plate pile with a memory
summary: Next to every plate, write the smallest plate in the pile at that moment, so the minimum is always on top.
goal: Support push, pop, top and get-minimum, each in one step

mapping.formal: Minimum of the pile at that moment

examples.label: Push −2, 0, −3
examples.explanation: After popping −3, the minimum is −2 again.

examples.label: Equal plates
examples.explanation: Popping one of two equal plates keeps the minimum.

examples.label: One plate
examples.explanation: With one plate, it is both the top and the minimum.

ladder.name: Scan the pile for the minimum
ladder.idea: Keep an ordinary stack; for getMin, look at every plate.

ladder.name: Write the minimum beside each plate
ladder.idea: When pushing, store the plate together with the smaller of it and the minimum below it. The minimum is always the note on top.
ladder.insight: The minimum of the pile only depends on the plates below the top, and a stack never changes those plates. So each plate can carry the minimum at the moment it was pushed.

transfer.problem: A browser's back button should also report the oldest date among pages in the history so far, instantly.
transfer.explanation: Store, beside each page pushed on the history stack, the oldest date at that moment.

selfCheck: Stores the current minimum with every pushed value.
Popping removes the value and its note together.
